instruments.notes: Open fixed price swap at 12/31/1994 (Company receives fixed, pays variable index such as NYMEX); hedges production. Combined fair value of all gas price swaps is $(1,010) thousand, not split by contract. Seven counterparties in total, not individually named.
instruments.evidence_quote:
One fixed
price swap contract was open at December 31, 1994 with a fixed price of $2.08
per Mmbtu, a contract period extending to March 1995 and open notional
quantities totalling 400,000 Mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Open variable price swap at 12/31/1994 (Company receives variable price, pays fixed); hedges purchased gas supplying a long-term fixed price contract; margin call requirement for obligations over $2 million. Price unit not explicit for the $1.60 in text. Combined fair value of all gas price swaps is $(1,010) thousand.
instruments.evidence_quote:
One variable price swap contract
was open at December 31, 1994 with a fixed price of $1.60, a contract period

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Uses natural gas price swaps to manage price risk on production, inventories, and purchased gas; swaps run a year or less; Company plans to continue this strategy.
